shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null; find .agents -type f

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui && sed -n 1,80p references/package-routing.md; echo ------; rg -n -i -C 3 "navigation|table|app shell|aside" references/package-routing.md | head -150

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head; cat src/* 2>/dev/null | head -60; cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

npm view @gravity-ui/navigation version peerDependencies 2>&1 | head -30; npm view @gravity-ui/table version peerDependencies dependencies 2>&1 | head -30; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@tanstack 2>/dev/null

npm install @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/table @gravity-ui/icons @gravity-ui/i18n @bem-react/classname @dnd-kit/core @dnd-kit/sortable lodash 2>&1 | tail -15; npm install -D @types/lodash 2>&1 | tail -3; for p in navigation table; do echo == $p; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/{dist,build}/docs 2>/dev/null | head; done

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && cat navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -80; ls navigation/build/docs/components; echo =====; cat table/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -80; ls table/build/docs/*
sed -n 80,400p table/build/docs/INDEX.md | rg -n -i -C 6 "reorder|grouping|groupe|getGroupedRowModel|selection|enableRowSelection" | head -230
sed -n 1,140p navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/table && sed -n 285,345p build/docs/INDEX.md; echo ----GROUP; sed -n 285,360p build/docs/INDEX.md >/dev/null; awk 'NR>=288 && NR<=360' build/docs/INDEX.md >/dev/null; rg -n -i "column.?reorder|ColumnOrder|columnOrder" build/docs -r '$0' | head -20; ls build/components build/hooks 2>/dev/null | head -60

sed -n 345,360p build/docs/INDEX.md; sed -n 478,510p build/docs/INDEX.md; echo; rg -n "Grouping|group" build/docs/components/BaseTable.md | head -20; cd ../navigation && rg -n -C3 "menuItems|MenuItem\b" build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | sed -n 1,60p; ls build/components/AsideHeader/ | head; rg -n "interface MenuItem" -A 40 build/components/types.d.ts | head -70

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && sed -n 25,50p table/build/docs/components/BaseTable.md | cut -c1-260; grep -rn "getIsGroupHeaderRow" table/build --include=*.js -h | head -5; grep -rln "interface MenuItem" navigation/build --include=*.d.ts | head;

grep -n "getIsGroupHeaderRow\|GroupHeader" table/build/cjs/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.js table/build/cjs/components/BaseTable/BaseTableBody.js 2>/dev/null | head -20; ls table/build/cjs/components/BaseTable | head -30; grep -n "interface MenuItem" -A 45 navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -80; cat table/build/esm/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.d.ts | head -5; cat table/build/esm/components/GroupHeader*/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/cjs && grep -rn "getIsGroupHeaderRow\|getIsGroupHeader" components/BaseTable/BaseTable.js | head; grep -rln "renderGroupHeader" components | head; sed -n 1,80p components/BaseTableBody/BaseTableBody.js 2>/dev/null | grep -n "GroupHeader\|isGroup" ; ls components | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm && grep -n "interface AsideHeaderGeneralProps\|interface AsideHeaderProps" -A 60 components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | grep -n "logo\|compact\|renderContent\|menuItems\|onChangeCompact\|className\|hideCollapseButton\|headerDecoration\|qa" | head -30; grep -n "interface LogoProps" -A 20 components/Logo/Logo.d.ts | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/cjs/components && cat BaseRow/utils/getRowContent.js | head -50; cat BaseGroupHeader/BaseGroupHeader.js | head -40; grep -n "Logo\b" -B2 -A12 /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/Logo/Logo.d.ts | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && cat table/build/esm/components/ColumnReorderingProvider/ColumnReorderingProvider.d.ts | head -30; grep -rn "useRowSelectionFixedHandler" table/build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -3; cat table/build/esm/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "LogoProps" -A 14 navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -24; grep -n "selectionColumn\|enableColumnReordering\|ColumnReordering" -r table/build/esm/types 2>/dev/null | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons && ls esm | grep -E "^(House|Persons|Person|ShoppingCart|Gear|Cubes3|Box)\.js$"; grep -o "export { default as \(House\|Persons\|ShoppingCart\|Gear\|Box\) }" esm/index.js; sed -n 1,40p ../table/build/esm/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.d.ts
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -40
grep -n "ColumnDef" node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/types/index.d.ts | head
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -20; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/types
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30
